name: Cancer Research UK
summary: The world's largest charitable funder of cancer research: grants to UK universities and hospitals, its own institutes and clinical trials units, and Cancer Research Horizons, which turns results into drugs and start-ups. It also campaigns on cancer policy (tobacco, screening, the National Cancer Plan) and runs public cancer information. Its shops help pay for it.
